$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-messagebird-sms-source). Seeds the pre-built `messagebird-sms` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's MessageBirdSmsClient. MessageBird (Bird) REST API authenticates with an `Authorization: AccessKey {key}` request header. Ships dormant (isEnabled:false) with the real MessageBird REST base URL and auth:apikey so a fresh install resolves the endpoint without carrying a secret. MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (MessageBird `/messages` shape, message id `MOCK-SMS-MB-0001`, recipient status `sent`) and isEnabled:true, so the dispatch leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT a MessageBird access key — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source and returns the canned success body WITHOUT sending an SMS. To go live: paste your MessageBird access key onto `configuration.headers.Authorization` as `AccessKey {your-key}` and REMOVE `configuration.mock`. The base URL is admin-owned on the source (no SSRF surface). OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST /messages) — provider selection / STOP opt-out / dedupe / delivery-status reconciliation stay in the consuming app (pipelinq SmsAdapter).
